query: begin; select set_config('request.jwt.claim.sub', 'd03fc0f2-f189-487c-b58f-2bc06e3aa59a', true); select set_config('app.task100_probe_result', (with conversation as (select public.customer_create_conversation('32fb6bdd-ceb4-4a8b-b6a1-1ac92c466c47'::uuid) as payload), message as (select public.customer_send_message((conversation.payload->>'id')::uuid, 'TASK100 rollback acceptance message', 'task100-message-rollback-probe') as payload from conversation), review as (select public.customer_create_review('91351884-521b-43d5-9869-aa3a178ebf94'::uuid, '32fb6bdd-ceb4-4a8b-b6a1-1ac92c466c47'::uuid, 5, 'TASK100 rollback acceptance review', 'task100-review-rollback-probe') as payload), comment as (select public.customer_create_comment('91351884-521b-43d5-9869-aa3a178ebf94'::uuid, 'TASK100 rollback acceptance comment', 'task100-comment-rollback-probe') as payload), request as (select public.customer_create_request('32fb6bdd-ceb4-4a8b-b6a1-1ac92c466c47'::uuid, 'TASK100 rollback acceptance request', 'read-only net-zero probe', null, null, null, null, null, '{}'::jsonb, '91351884-521b-43d5-9869-aa3a178ebf94'::uuid, 1, 'task100-request-rollback-probe') as payload), follow_first as (select public.customer_toggle_store_follow('32fb6bdd-ceb4-4a8b-b6a1-1ac92c466c47'::uuid) as payload), follow_second as (select public.customer_toggle_store_follow('32fb6bdd-ceb4-4a8b-b6a1-1ac92c466c47'::uuid) as payload), like_first as (select public.customer_toggle_product_like('91351884-521b-43d5-9869-aa3a178ebf94'::uuid) as payload), like_second as (select public.customer_toggle_product_like('91351884-521b-43d5-9869-aa3a178ebf94'::uuid) as payload) select jsonb_build_object('auth_uid', 'd03fc0f2-f189-487c-b58f-2bc06e3aa59a', 'conversation', conversation.payload, 'message', message.payload, 'review', review.payload, 'comment', comment.payload, 'request', request.payload, 'follow_first', follow_first.payload, 'follow_second', follow_second.payload, 'like_first', like_first.payload, 'like_second', like_second.payload) from conversation, message, review, comment, request, follow_first, follow_second, like_first, like_second limit 1)::text, false); rollback; select current_setting('app.task100_probe_result', true) as rollback_probe_result from (select 1) as result limit 1;
